execution_caveat: This source inventory is not a cargo-generated execution list. Actual skipped counts remain those in each hosted nextest summary. Some ignored private workers are invoked explicitly by bounded parent tests; manual benchmarks and host/oracle qualification declarations must not be counted as executed merely because a parent or the default suite passed.
